hints.title: Double Player Join
hints.text: Join the Passes table with Teams on both pass_from and pass_to to identify the passing and receiving teams.

hints.title: Match Half Categorization
hints.text: Determine the match half: 1 if time_stamp is at most 45:00, otherwise 2.

hints.title: Net Dominance Sum
hints.text: Sum 1 for completed passes within the same team and -1 for turnovers to the opposing team grouped by team and half.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH PassDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        T1.team_name AS from_team,
        T2.team_name AS to_team,
        CASE 
            WHEN Passes.time_stamp <= '45:00' THEN 1 
            ELSE 2 
        END AS half_number
    FROM Passes
    JOIN Teams T1 ON Passes.pass_from = T1.player_id
    JOIN Teams T2 ON Passes.pass_to = T2.player_id
)
SELECT 
    from_team AS team_name,
    half_number,
    SUM(CASE WHEN from_team = to_team THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS dominance
FROM PassDetails
GROUP BY from_team, half_number
ORDER BY team_name ASC, half_number ASC;
```

variables: m: count of pass records in Passes table
complexity.notes: Double table join assigns team names, partitions by half number (00:00-45:00 vs 45:01-90:00), and computes net dominance.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Requires joining player identities to teams and evaluating timestamp ranges.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Performs multi-table joins with conditional aggregation and timestamp filtering.

WITH PassDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        T1.team_name AS from_team,
        T2.team_name AS to_team,
        CASE 
            WHEN Passes.time_stamp <= '45:00' THEN 1 
            ELSE 2 
        END AS half_number
    FROM Passes
    JOIN Teams T1 ON Passes.pass_from = T1.player_id
    JOIN Teams T2 ON Passes.pass_to = T2.player_id
)
SELECT 
    from_team AS team_name,
    half_number,
    SUM(CASE WHEN from_team = to_team THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS dominance
FROM PassDetails
GROUP BY from_team, half_number
ORDER BY team_name ASC, half_number ASC;

import pandas as pd

def calculate_team_dominance(teams: pd.DataFrame, passes: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    merged = passes.merge(teams, left_on='pass_from', right_on='player_id').rename(columns={'team_name': 'from_team'})
    merged = merged.merge(teams, left_on='pass_to', right_on='player_id').rename(columns={'team_name': 'to_team'})
    merged['half_number'] = (merged['time_stamp'] > '45:00').astype(int) + 1
    merged['dominance'] = (merged['from_team'] == merged['to_team']).astype(int) * 2 - 1
    res = merged.groupby(['from_team', 'half_number'])['dominance'].sum().reset_index()
    return res.rename(columns={'from_team': 'team_name'}).sort_values(['team_name', 'half_number'])
